Job Description:
Executive Assistant

Help Finance leaders stay focused, prepared, and moving forward.

This is an opportunity to become a trusted partner to Resmed’s Finance Leadership Team, supporting leaders across the U.S. West Coast and Australia.

As Executive Assistant, you’ll go beyond traditional administrative support by helping leaders prioritize their time, prepare for critical discussions, coordinate leadership activities, and drive follow-through on decisions and commitments.

You’ll bring structure to a fast-moving global environment, connecting priorities, people, meetings, and information so leaders can focus on the work that matters most. From coordinating leadership rhythms and executive communications to global travel and offsites, you’ll help Finance leadership operate with clarity and consistency.

This role requires flexibility to adjust working hours to support leaders across U.S. West Coast and Australia time zones.

What You'll Do

- Manage complex global calendars, aligning leadership time with high-impact priorities while anticipating conflicts, dependencies, and changing needs.

- Build an understanding of Finance priorities, stakeholders, and business rhythms to anticipate needs, connect the dots and recommend practical solutions.

- Coordinate Finance Leadership Team meetings, business reviews, planning sessions, offsites, and conferences, including agendas, pre-reads, stakeholder inputs, logistics, and materials.

- Track decisions, actions, and key dependencies to create visibility, reinforce accountability and support follow-through.

- Prepare executive communications, presentations, and leadership materials that are clear, organized, and appropriate for senior audiences.

- Coordinate stakeholder inputs for external reporting, announcements, Board-related activities, and Investor Relations.

- Partner across Finance, senior leadership, external stakeholders, and Resmed’s global Executive Assistant network to keep information and activities moving effectively.

- Plan complex global travel, including itineraries and logistics, and manage related expenses.

- Drive coordination for special projects and cross-functional initiatives involving multiple senior stakeholders, bringing structure to complex or ambiguous work.

- Improve administrative and leadership processes using Microsoft 365, Copilot, automation, and emerging AI tools to simplify work and improve productivity.

What You Bring

- Experience supporting senior executives or leadership teams in complex, global, high-pressure environments.

- Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities, complex schedules, and leadership team activities.

- Strong written and verbal communication, with confidence engaging senior internal and external stakeholders.

- Ability to anticipate needs, navigate ambiguity, solve problems independently, and exercise discretion, integrity, and sound judgment in sensitive situations.

- Proficiency with Microsoft 365, including Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams, and Excel, with effective use of AI tools such as Copilot.

- Flexibility to adjust working hours to support U.S. West Coast and Australia time zones.

- Nice to have

- Experience supporting Finance, Accounting, Investor Relations, Strategy, a CFO organization, or another enterprise function.

- Experience in a global, publicly traded, healthcare, medical technology, or regulated environment.

- Project coordination or program management experience supporting business reviews, offsites, or large-scale leadership meetings.

What Sets You Apart

- Anticipation: You look ahead, identify what leaders will need next, and act before competing priorities become obstacles.

- Judgment: You navigate sensitive matters thoughtfully, knowing when to act independently and how to manage information and access with discretion.

- Ownership: You follow commitments through to completion and create confidence that important details won’t get lost.

- Adaptability: You stay composed when priorities shift and respond practically to change across a complex global environment.

- Business Curiosity: You seek to understand the business behind the work, connecting priorities, stakeholders, and information to anticipate needs and become a more effective partner.

Why Join Resmed
At Resmed, your work helps enable a mission focused on helping people breathe better and live healthier, longer lives. You’ll work across a global Finance leadership environment, helping leaders operate effectively while shaping smarter ways of working through Microsoft 365, Copilot, automation, and emerging AI tools.

Job Title: Senior Executive Assistant to the Founder
Job Description:
Hey! Alex here, founder of Elavate. I'm writing this one myself because you'll be working directly with me.

- Salary: £80,000+ base

- Location: Remote-first (we do have a London Office where some of our team work from)

- Reports to: Me, directly

- Hours: Full-time, but not a 9-to-5. Read "The hours" below before you apply

Who we are
We're the fastest-growing DTC brand in the UK. We sell a collagen supplement for women in their 40s, 50s and beyond.
We've grown to over £100M in annual revenue, completely bootstrapped. Now we're looking to keep taking over the UK collagen market and grow into the USA.
We have a warm, friendly culture. We're fast-growing and ambitious, and as we grow we need more smart people. You'll work with other smart people on meaningful, exciting work every day.
About the role
As Elavate keeps growing, there's loads coming up, so I'm looking for one sharp person to be my right hand. Someone I can hand anything to: my inbox, my Slack, the threads I haven't got to and the random projects that land on my desk.
Over time you become a version of me for everything outside creative, so I can spend my time on growth and the future direction of the company, our creative team and our rapid US expansion. Right now I spend around 6 hours a day clearing Slack and email before I get to the real work. Your job is to give me most of that back.
This isn't a diary-and-travel EA role. I barely travel and there isn't much personal admin. It's the business: hundreds of messages a week, lots of open loops, and someone good enough to handle most of it the way I would.
What you'll own

- My inbox. Stay on top of it: four sweeps a day, replies in my voice that I don't need to check, drafts for the rest, and every thread closed out.

- Very fast Slack replies. This one's really important. Clear the chats that don't need me, reply in thread, and only bring me what actually needs me.

- A daily roundup waiting when I'm online at midday: what needs me today, what you're handling, and what you've closed.

- Follow-ups and chasing. Be very organised and diligent here. If I've said it, it's written down, tracked and chased with the right people until it's closed, including by email as me.

- Meetings and calls. Prep notes before, recorded, then a summary and actions the next day. You'll also sit in on our weekly creative review and on supplier and partner calls, and hold people to their timelines.

- People and hiring admin. Hiring admin with our recruiters, onboarding and offboarding, and people admin for our international team.

- Trackers. A contracts and renewals tracker, plus cost tracking for things like influencer spend and software subscriptions.

- Admin that just happens. Invoices paid fast, plus the bookings that keep things moving (team hotel nights, padel, Airbnbs for shoots, team gifts) without checking in with me.

- Side projects outside everyone's remit. The things I've spotted but don't have time for, that don't sit in anyone's normal job. You dig in, figure it out and close it.

- SOPs in Notion as you go, so nothing lives only in my/your head.

What success looks like after 3 months

- I don't open my inbox or the misc Slack threads. You've handled them in my tone and I didn't need to check.

- Nothing I mention gets dropped.

- Every meeting has prep before it and a summary after.

- Bookings and admin happen without me thinking about them.

- I've got most of those 6 hours a day back.

Who you are

- Very sharp. You read between the lines, get context fast and figure things out on your own. If I mention something once, it's handled.

- Technical and fluent in AI. You build your own custom workflows and automations (Claude Code, n8n or whatever does the job), and you pick up new tools really fast.

- Proactive and independent. You don't wait to be told. You ask what you need, then follow up with the right people, chase and close things out yourself.

- Calm, organised and diligent. You bring order to a busy founder and a fast-moving business, and follow-ups never slip.

- A great writer. You can write as someone else and nobody can tell.

- Discreet. You'll see sensitive commercial, financial and people matters every day.

- Always learning. A positive, growth mindset. You want to get better every week.

- Locked in. You want this, and it shows from the first conversation.

Experience

- You've been the right hand to a founder, CEO or C-suite exec in a fast-moving business (EA, chief of staff, founder's associate or similar).

- You're fluent in Google Workspace, Slack and Notion, and at home in Google Sheets.

- You don't need e-commerce experience. You do need to be technical: someone who learns new skills and adopts them really fast.

- Bonus points if you've built something of your own. Everyone here is a builder in their own way.

Where it goes next
The role grows into chief of staff. That's the next step: working with me on the most important projects in the business. You'll see every part of a fast-growing brand up close.
The hours (please read this bit)
This isn't a typical 9-to-5 role. It also isn't literally 24/7, but I need someone who's always available, whether that's early in the morning or throughout the day.
My day starts late (12pm) and runs into the early hours, and most of what I send goes out after 6pm. You clear what came in overnight so the roundup is ready when I'm online, and you're quick on Slack in the evenings.
If you clock out at the end of a 9-to-5 and don't check or reply to messages after that, this won't work for me. This part is non-negotiable.
What you get

- £80,000+ starting base, depending on experience

- A real path into a chief of staff role, if that's where you want to go

- A 3-month review against clear goals, with your base stepping up when you hit them

- 30 days off a year

- Vitality private health insurance

- Travel allowance for trips to the London office

- Free Elavate, obviously

How we hire
An intro call, an interview with me, a paid test task, then a final interview. There's a short reasoning test along the way. We move fast.

- Respond to queries and provide supporting information to our UK and Hong Kong accountants

- Document filing and record-keeping across the four entities

- General administrative support for the operations team

- 2–5 years of experience in bookkeeping, finance administration or a similar hands-on finance role

- Experience handling accounts payable, accounts receivable, invoicing and expenses

- Good understanding of month-end bookkeeping processes

- Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail

- Comfortable working independently in a remote environment

- Organised and consistent in maintaining records and following established processes

- Confident communicating with colleagues and accountants

- Good written and spoken English

- Comfortable working across multiple entities and currencies

This is a full-time contractor engagement, not an employment position.

Venture Media is a full-service content marketing agency. We help businesses grow through social media, podcast production, SEO and AI visibility, and full-funnel content systems. We are a small, fast-moving remote team that ships real client work every week.

The role
We are looking for a Marketing Assistant to support content production and daily execution across our client accounts and internal brands. You will keep the content engine running: scheduling posts, prepping assets, and running research. Your job will be across assistant and marketing work, so you should like variety.

Marketing expertise is a plus for this role, but it is not required. What matters most is having a basic understanding of marketing and a genuine desire to learn and develop deeper expertise. We use automation and clear systems for the heavy lifting, so your job is less about busywork and more about keeping things organized, checking quality, and helping our content and clients look great. You will work directly with the founder and learn how a modern agency runs end to end.

What you will do

- Content coordination and publishing. Schedule and publish blogs and posts, keep our content calendar organized, and make sure everything goes out on time. Much of the writing is already automated, so your role is organizing, reviewing, and adding the final human touch.

- Quality control. Do a first pass on assets from our editors, proofread copy and decks before they go to clients, and make sure feedback actually gets addressed.

- Research and reporting. Run market research for projects as needed, and help pull simple analytics reports so we know what is working.

- Social and community support. Help manage engagement and distribution across our platforms, and keep our own brand active and consistent.

- Light marketing execution. Learn the basics of SEO and AI search visibility, and help apply them to our content. We will teach you this piece by piece.

- General right-hand work. Jump on whatever the day needs. Some days that is research, some days it is organizing a project in our task tools, some days it is prepping something for a client.

What we are looking for

- Bachelor's in a related field or equivalent hands-on experience

- 1 to 2 years in a marketing, social media, communications, or administrative role, ideally at an agency 

- Extremely organized and proactive, able to juggle multiple priorities and stay detailed under deadline

- Comfortable with the major social platforms (Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube) and scheduling tools

- Familiar with project management software

- A reliable communicator who keeps managers updated and follows through without being chased

- A flexible team player who adapts to shifting priorities and jumps in where needed

- Clear written English and comfort in an async remote setup

- Available during US Pacific business hours so we can work in real time

- Dedicated to this as your main full-time focus, not a side gig

Nice to have (not required)

- SEO or AI search visibility experience

- Experience with task managers like ClickUp

Who this is not for
This is not a fit if you need constant hand-holding, avoid feedback, or prefer slow work with a lot of meetings. We move fast, hold clear standards, and expect you to own your tasks.

What you get

- An hourly rate of $20 to $25 USD, based on your experience.

- Direct mentorship from the founder and a front-row seat to how a marketing agency runs

- Real room to grow. As we grow, you grow, in both responsibility and pay

- A long-term home, not a short-term contract

About Blue Oak Consulting
 Blue Oak Consulting provides independent advisory on pricing, portfolio economics, capital allocation, and acquisition assumptions. We are not a traditional consulting firm focused on broad transformation programs or high level strategy decks. Instead, we interrogate specific commercial decisions where the financial stakes are high and the existing narrative is not sufficient. Our team looks past corporate language and P&L complexity to identify where value is leaking or capital is trapped. We work across sectors like software, manufacturing, and healthcare to test whether the assumptions behind a growth plan or an acquisition actually hold under pressure. We are a small, principal led firm where the people who do the work are the ones accountable for the results. We do not take transaction contingent fees, which allows us to be completely honest about whether the economics of a decision make sense. Our goal is to provide clarity through financial discipline and a healthy amount of skepticism.
 
The Role
 This is a full time, permanent position that is conducted entirely in a remote environment. You will work closely with our principals to dig into the numbers provided by our partners, often starting with the Italian infrastructure project. The goal is to move past P&L complexity and find where value might be leaking. You will be expected to think critically and ask why certain numbers exist high up in a spreadsheet, rather than just accepting them as facts. This role offers an attractive and competitive compensation package for an entry level professional looking to gain deep experience in financial analysis.
 
What You Will Be Doing 
- Cleaning and organizing large datasets from various sources to build a clear financial picture.
 
- Testing the logic behind pricing assumptions to see if they survive real world friction.
 
- Helping build financial models that track capital allocation across different infrastructure assets.
 
- Identifying outliers and anomalies in expenditure reports that do not align with the stated narrative.
 
- Updating portfolio economics trackers to reflect new acquisition data.
 
- Collaborating with the team through virtual channels to clarify findings and refine analysis.
 
- Preparing clear summaries of data trends that highlight potential financial risks.
 
- Verifying the accuracy of inputs used in growth forecasts for specific business units.
 
- Assisting in the interrogation of acquisition assumptions for new investment opportunities.

What You Bring 
- A degree or background in finance, economics, mathematics, or a related field with a heavy emphasis on data.
 
- Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including the ability to manage complex formulas and large tables.
 
- A skeptical mindset that enjoys finding inconsistencies in spreadsheets and reports.
 
- Comfort working in a fully remote setting where communication is largely written and specific.
 
- Ability to organize messy data into structured formats without losing important context.
 
- Interest in how large businesses actually spend money and allocate internal capital.
 
- Reliability and a willingness to learn how to scrutinize financial statements at a deep level.
 
- Strong attention to detail, especially when reviewing line items that seem out of place.

What We Offer 
- A fully remote work schedule that provides flexibility and removes the need for a daily commute.
 
- Direct access to firm principals who provide mentorship and clear feedback on your work.
 
- The opportunity to work on high stakes projects, such as our current work with the Italian infrastructure group.
 
- A professional environment focused on logic and evidence rather than corporate politics.
 
- Practical training in financial modeling and capital allocation analysis.
 
- A permanent, stable role within a firm that values individual accountability and results.

 At Blue Oak Consulting, we believe that clarity comes from discipline and a healthy amount of skepticism. We stay through the execution phase of our projects because we know that decisions looking sound in theory often face challenges once they meet reality. This role is a starting point for someone who wants to understand the mechanics of how value is created and protected in large organizations. We value the work over the performance, and we look for assistants who are eager to show how the numbers actually add up without relying on corporate jargon.

Mosaic Conseil operates as a small, remote workshop dedicated to rebuilding one business artifact at a time. Whether it is a three year plan, a pricing grid, or a diligence file, we take things apart on the bench and put them back together against the evidence of the invoice ledger. The process is personal and focused. We do not work on standing retainers and we do not produce slide decks. Instead, we return the same artifact you sent, redrawn by hand and supported by a written argument. Our work is handled on paper and backed by a telephone number that answers for ninety days. We keep the workshop small on purpose to ensure that the people who do the work also answer their own phones. There are no meetings we did not schedule and no corporate theater. We focus on four specific rooms: financial services, industrial networks, growing software companies, and healthcare systems.
 
About Mosaic Conseil
 We are a boutique consultancy that values intellectual honesty and the discipline of a small, focused team. By staying small and fully remote, we remain independent and focused on the evidence at the floor of the business. Our clients come to us when they need a business plan or a financial model rebuilt with extreme precision. We provide a workspace where the primary goal is getting the numbers and the logic right, rather than making things look good in a presentation. Every file that leaves our workshop carries two names on the cover: one person who builds and one who argues against what was built. This ensures that every assumption is tested before a file closes. This environment is built for thinkers who prefer a written argument over a status meeting.
 
What you would do
 As an AI Testing Assistant, your work focuses on the intersection of business logic and automated analysis. You will be responsible for testing the outputs of AI models used to process financial and industrial data. This is an entry level role where you support our consultants by stress testing the artifacts we build. Your day to day work involves: 
- Reviewing AI generated summaries and data extractions for accuracy against original source documents like ledgers or contracts.
 
- Running standardized tests on internal AI tools to identify where they fail to grasp complex financial logic or industrial constraints.
 
- Building simple test cases to verify that a pricing model or a business plan remains consistent when variables are changed.
 
- Documenting specific instances of model error or hallucination in a clear, written format.
 
- Assisting the challenger in our builder and challenger model by providing evidence of where an automated calculation may have deviated from the truth.
 
- Comparing different AI model outputs to see which one handles specific industry terminology from healthcare or industrial networks more reliably.
 
- Verifying that the data used for a specific business artifact has been correctly mapped by our automated scripts.

Helpful background
 We are looking for individuals who have a natural curiosity about how technology works and, more importantly, how it breaks. This role is accessible to those starting their career or looking for part time work while finishing their studies. Helpful traits and experiences include: 
- Basic familiarity with Large Language Models and an understanding of how to prompt them for technical tasks.
 
- Competence in using spreadsheets like Excel or Google Sheets to verify calculations.
 
- Strong writing skills and the ability to explain a technical error in plain English.
 
- A background in business, finance, or computer science is useful but we value the ability to follow a logical argument above a specific degree.
 
- Technical comfort with remote work tools and a disciplined approach to managing your own schedule.
 
- Experience with personal projects or academic work that involves data analysis or AI testing.
 
- An interest in the specific sectors we serve, particularly financial services and industrial networks.

How we work
 Our workshop is entirely remote, meaning you can work from wherever you are most productive. We do not have an office and we do not hold meetings unless they are strictly necessary for the work. We communicate primarily through written documents and internal notes. Our builder and challenger model means that your work as a tester is central to our reputation. You are not just a support person: you are an essential part of the verification process that allows us to stand behind every artifact we produce. We prioritize deep work and give our team the quiet they need to find the errors that others miss. There is no requirement for residency in a specific city or country, as we operate a global, decentralized bench.
 
What the role offers
 This is a part time, contract position that is fully remote. You will have the opportunity to learn how high level business artifacts are constructed and how AI can be reliably integrated into professional services. The work is intellectually demanding and avoids the typical overhead of corporate life. We provide a space where you can focus on technical competence and analytical rigor. The position is paid and the pay is attractive for the role and the market, reflecting the care and attention to detail we expect from our testers. You will work directly with experienced professionals who answer their own phones and audit their own work, offering a direct view into the mechanics of boutique consultancy.
 Precision in our workshop is not a goal but a requirement. We believe that a business artifact is only as good as the evidence that supports it, and as an AI Testing Assistant, you are the one who ensures that evidence is sound. By looking for the cracks in the model before the client sees the work, you help us maintain a standard of intellectual honesty that is rare in modern consulting. Our process is slow by design, allowing for the kind of thoroughness that a faster, larger firm cannot provide.

Operating cadence

Craft the materials that shape the company's most important conversations: board updates, executive memos, decision briefs, CEO communications, investor-ready narratives, and sensitive internal messaging. Turn complex issues into crisp, well-structured communication tailored to senior audiences. Job Title: Executive Assistant to the Chief Revenue Officer (CRO)
Job Description:
A Little About Us

EDB provides a data and AI platform that enables organizations to harness the full power of Postgres for transactional, analytical, and AI workloads across any cloud, anywhere. EDB empowers enterprises to control risk, manage costs and scale efficiently for a data and AI led world. Serving more than 1,500 customers globally and as the leading contributor to the vibrant and fast-growing PostgreSQL community, EDB supports major government organizations, financial services, media and information technology companies. EDB’s data-driven solutions enable customers to modernize legacy systems and break data silos while leveraging enterprise-grade open source technologies. EDB delivers the confidence of up to 99.999% high availability with mission critical capabilities built in such as security, compliance controls, and observability. For more information, visit www.enterprisedb.com

Position Overview

The Executive Assistant to the Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) serves as a strategic business partner responsible for maximizing the effectiveness, focus, and operational efficiency of a global revenue executive. This role extends well beyond traditional administrative support and requires strong business acumen, executive presence, sound judgment, and the ability to proactively manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, revenue-driven environment.

The Executive Assistant acts as an extension of the CRO's office, ensuring priorities are surfaced, decisions are supported, communication flows effectively, and critical business initiatives remain on track. Success in this role requires exceptional organizational skills, proactive problem-solving, discretion, and the ability to coordinate across global teams and stakeholders.

Location: Boston-based or nearby (ideal) / Eastern Time preferred

Requirements:

- Flexibility to support a globally distributed leadership team across time zones

- Current passport and ability to travel as needed

- Availability to respond to time-sensitive business matters outside standard business hours when required

Key Responsibilities

Executive Partnership & Leadership Support

- Serve as a trusted advisor and strategic partner to the CRO.

- Anticipate needs, identify potential challenges, and proactively develop solutions.

- Optimize the CRO's time, focus, and decision-making through effective prioritization and coordination.

- Manage and triage executive communications, ensuring critical priorities receive timely attention.

- Raise emerging priorities, flag risks, bottlenecks, and delays, and drive appropriate follow-up.

- Prepare executive briefings, agendas, meeting materials, and decision-support documents.

- Track key initiatives, commitments, action items, and deliverables to ensure accountability and execution.

- Handle highly confidential and sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.

Executive Inbox & Communication Management

- Proactively manage the CRO's inbox and communication flow.

- Prioritize incoming requests, identify urgent matters, and ensure timely responses.

- Surface critical business issues requiring executive attention.

- Draft communications and coordinate follow-up across internal and external stakeholders.

- Monitor commitments and escalate unresolved items that may impact business objectives.

Global Calendar Management

- Own and manage a highly complex global calendar spanning multiple time zones.

- Balance executive leadership meetings, customer engagements, board interactions, investor meetings, travel schedules, and strategic priorities.

- Exercise strong judgment when managing scheduling conflicts and competing demands.

- Coordinate effectively with executives, sales leaders, customers, partners, and external stakeholders.

- Ensure the CRO's time is aligned to the highest-value business opportunities and revenue priorities.

Global Travel Management

- Plan and execute complex domestic and international travel arrangements.

- Develop optimized travel schedules that maximize customer engagement and business impact.

- Coordinate flights, accommodations, transportation, visas, travel documentation, and contingency plans.

- Partner with regional teams to ensure productive and efficient travel itineraries.

- Manage travel disruptions and last-minute changes with urgency and professionalism.

Event & Meeting Management

- Lead the planning and execution of executive-level meetings and events, including:

- Global Sales Meetings

- Customer and Partner Events

- Sales Leadership Offsites

- Executive Roundtables and Dinners

- Revenue Organization Meetings

- Manage venues, vendors, budgets, communications, logistics, attendee coordination, and executive preparation.

- Deliver seamless event experiences that support business objectives and stakeholder engagement.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Coordination

- Serve as a central coordination point across the revenue organization.

- Build strong relationships with executive leadership, sales leaders, customers, partners, and cross-functional teams.

- Facilitate communication, alignment, and follow-through across distributed teams.

- Represent the CRO's office with professionalism, credibility, and sound judgment.

- Drive execution by ensuring stakeholders remain informed, aligned, and accountable.

Administrative & Operational Excellence

- Manage expenses, invoices, procurement activities, and administrative processes.

- Support leadership meetings, quarterly business reviews, planning cycles, and organizational initiatives.

- Maintain operational trackers, reporting tools, and executive workflows.

- Continuously identify opportunities to improve efficiency, streamline processes, and enhance executive effectiveness.

- Establish and maintain systems that improve visibility into priorities, commitments, and follow-up actions.

Required Skills & Competencies

- Exceptional organizational, planning, and prioritization abilities.

- Advanced executive calendar and travel management expertise.

- Strong executive presence and communication skills.

- Proven ability to manage competing priorities with sound judgment.

- Experience supporting high-growth, fast-paced organizations.

- Ability to proactively identify issues, risks, and dependencies.

- Strong attention to detail and follow-through.

- High degree of discretion and professionalism.

- Ability to influence outcomes and drive accountability without direct authority.

- Comfortable operating across multiple time zones and global teams.

- Adaptability and resilience in rapidly changing environments.

Experience & Qualifications

- 7+ years of experience supporting senior executives, preferably within revenue, sales, or go-to-market organizations.

- Demonstrated success supporting global leadership teams.

- Significant experience planning and executing executive-level meetings and events.

- Extensive experience coordinating complex domestic and international travel.

- Proficiency with Google Workspace and modern productivity tools.

- Experience working with confidential business information and executive communications.

Working Style & Expectations

- Highly proactive and solutions-oriented.

- Operates with urgency while maintaining accuracy and professionalism.

- Anticipates needs rather than reacting to requests.

- Comfortable making decisions and exercising independent judgment.

- Maintains composure under pressure and during periods of ambiguity.

- Acts as a trusted extension of the CRO's leadership office.

- Demonstrates flexibility to support global business needs and executive priorities.

Success in This Role Looks Like

- The CRO's time is consistently aligned to strategic and revenue-generating priorities.

- Critical communications, decisions, and follow-ups are managed proactively.

- Inbox management is efficient, organized, and focused on business impact.

- Risks, delays, and bottlenecks are identified and escalated before they become issues.

- Global travel and executive events run seamlessly.

- Stakeholders experience clear communication, strong coordination, and timely execution.

- Business priorities remain visible, organized, and moving forward.
